pairs: The Lord is the God of retribution.
The God of retribution acts in order to deliver.
How long will they utter and speak iniquity?
How long will all who work injustice speak out?
O Lord, and they have harassed your inheritance.
They have executed the widow and the new arrival,
and they have slaughtered the orphan.
nor will the God of Jacob understand.”
you senseless ones among the people.
He who formed the ear, will he not hear?
aut qui finxit oculum non considerat?
And he who forged the eye, does he not look closely?
he who teaches man knowledge, will he not rebuke?
The Lord knows the thoughts of men:
Blessed is the man whom you will instruct,
et de lege tua docueris eum:
And you will teach him from your law.
ut mitiges ei a diebus malis,
So may you soothe him from the evil days,
until a pit may be dug for sinners.
Quia non repellet Dominus plebem suam,
For the Lord will not drive away his people,
and he will not abandon his inheritance,
even until the time when justice is being converted into judgment,
et qui juxta illam, omnes qui recto sunt corde.
and when those who are close to justice are all those who are upright of heart.
Who will rise up with me against the malignant?
aut quis stabit mecum adversus operantes iniquitatem?
Or who will stand with me against the workers of iniquity?
Except that the Lord assisted me,
paulominus habitasset in inferno anima mea.
my soul almost would have dwelt in Hell.
Secundum multitudinem dolorum meorum in corde meo,
According to the multitude of my sorrows in my heart,
your consolations have given joy to my soul.
Does the seat of iniquity adhere to you,
you who contrive hardship within a commandment?
They will hunt down the soul of the just,
and they will condemn innocent blood.
Et factus est mihi Dominus in refugium,
And the Lord has been made into a refuge for me,
et Deus meus in adjutorium spei meæ.
and my God into the assistance of my hope.
And he will repay them their iniquity,
et in malitia eorum disperdet eos:
and he will destroy them in their malice.
The Lord our God will utterly destroy them.
